summary: Iteration 221: Decoder Health Dashboard and IPFS Cache Manager features tested. All 7 features verified working correctly. Backend API returns decoder stats with independence_score, sources, by_path, and recent events. Frontend Admin Dashboard shows Decoder Health tab with all required UI elements. Settings > Data and Storage shows IPFS Content Cache with 48 items (36.8 MB), toggle, Clear All Cache, and Browse Cache functionality. Settings > Network > Connect Your Node section renders correctly (regression check passed).

issues: 504 errors on some IPFS content requests (external gateway timeouts, not app issue)

critical_code_review_comments: stats_tracker.py: Clean implementation of track_decoder_source() with proper source categorization (local_decoder, p2fk_io, cache_fresh, cache_stale)
helpers.py: Correctly calls track_decoder_source() in p2fk_get() for all data source paths
AdminDashboard.js: DecoderHealthPanel component properly displays Independence Score, Source Breakdown cards, By API Path table, and Recent Events table
SettingsModal.js: IpfsCacheManager component correctly imports getCacheStats/clearCache/removeCached from ipfsCache.js and displays cache stats with browse functionality
context_for_next_testing_agent: Decoder Health Dashboard and IPFS Cache Manager features fully implemented and tested. Backend uses SQLite (NOT MongoDB) for caching. Admin auth: POST /api/admin/login with {username, password} returns {token}. System stats at GET /api/admin/system-stats with Authorization: Bearer {token}. Decoder stats are in tracker.decoder field with independence_score, sources, by_path, recent. Frontend: Admin Dashboard > Decoder Health tab shows all stats. Settings > Data and Storage shows IPFS Content Cache with item count, size, toggle, clear/browse actions. Settings > Network > Connect Your Node section has Auto-Detect and Manual Setup buttons.
